title: Francium (Solana) — wind-down vaults; value-moving withdrawals authorization-gated (E-U $0)
closed_reasons: SwapAndWithdraw: attacker signer + victim user_info reverts with NeedUserOrAdminPermission (6027) at programs/lyf-raydium/src/wind_down.rs:110 — caller must be position owner or strategy admin
SwapAndWithdraw: attacker-owned destination token accounts revert with ConstraintRaw (2003) on user_tkn_account_0 — destinations bound to the position owner
Permissionless Liquidate* paths repay strategy debt to receive LP collateral of dead Raydium/Orca pools (unpriced), with ~20x compounded debt — no net attacker profit found
Lending program FC81 has no obligation accounts; borrows are strategy credit accounts; reserves are in retained wind-down (stale/zero oracle), share redemption is user-gated
Reward program farmer PDA seeds are [user, pool, user_ata] and rewards are paid to the farmer's own stored reward account; unstake requires the user's stake account

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Francium (Solana): the main value path (SwapAndWithdraw) is proven to require the position owner or strategy admin (NeedUserOrAdminPermission 6027) and binds destinations to the owner (ConstraintRaw 2003), while permissionless liquidations repay debt for dead-pool LP collateral; ~$1.077M remains user-recoverable (H-O) under a live, upgradeable team authority (P).
